source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Search for all tests of the a test witness (i.e. one test candle, one bottle etc) with a failure in a common property (length of time, height of flame, etc)
    1. This is a candidate for the test method being disqualified
    2. Search for all reported specifications of that property
        1. If there are no specs, mark them as removable
        2. If there are specs, search for reports that specify that advertised property.
            1. If there are, mark them as disqualified
                1. Determine the appropriate reason using [these requirements](https://github.com/Turbo87/Turbo87-Schemas/blob/master/request_disqualification.md)
                2. If multiple reasons are apparent, the most severe takes effect.
            2. If there aren't any that specified the property, mark the test record as removable.
3. Repeat
